thread:
incident-bot: [P1] 1716009876 - Elevated 5xx + TCP resets for model-inference endpoints routed via us-west-1. Error spike > 7% and several long-tail latencies. Auto-escalate to #incidents.

oncall-zoe: got the page, I'm on call. standing by.

sre-omar: jumping in — initial metrics: 5xx concentrated to routes with prefer=us-west-1. Other regions nominal. No deploys in last 30m.

net-ben: checking network view. provider status shows "partial edge egress failure" in us-west-1; BGP flaps recorded for a subset of prefixes starting ~1716009500. also seeing DNS inconsistencies where some resolvers return older A records.

infra-kai: looking at pod-level: kube probes failing intermittently on startup, connections to external DNS hanging ~1.5s then timeout. app logs show repeated connection reset by peer.

support-maya: inbound support tickets from two enterprise customers on long-running batch jobs failing. they want ETA.

oncall-zoe: quick impact summary for comms: ~8% of production requests routed to us-west-1 experiencing errors/timeouts. We'll need mitigation now.

sre-omar: agree. two-pronged approach per DR runbook: 1) confirm whether DNS cache + egress blackhole or host-level. 2) if routing/DNS, perform staged traffic redistribution (failover) and lower DNS TTLs to accelerate cutover.

net-ben: probes:
```
# spot checks
dig @8.8.8.8 model-api.prod.redwood.internal +short
dig @1.1.1.1 model-api.prod.redwood.internal +short
traceroute -n 10.23.5.12
birdc show route
```

net-ben: results: 8.8.8.8 returns current A set, 1.1.1.1 returning smaller set (missing some edges) — signs of inconsistent propagation. traceroute shows last hop drop for ~3/16 prefixes. this is provider-side egress.

infra-kai: prepping traffic manager. initiating dry-run to estimate RPS and capacity headroom in target regions (us-east-1, eu-west-1).

deploy-bot: traffic-shift dry-run OK: estimated rebalanced RPS -> us-east-1: 12k, eu-west-1: 3.5k. no quota blocks.

infra-kai: starting staged shift (step 1 = 40%):
```
./tools/traffic-cli shift --from us-west-1 --to us-east-1,eu-west-1 --policy staged --step 1
```

sre-omar: watching SLOs. error-rate on affected routes dropping from 7.9% -> 4.2% within 90s. lat p95 improving. good to proceed if stable.

support-maya: updated status page: "We are experiencing regional network issues affecting a subset of requests in us-west-1. We're rerouting traffic to healthy regions; intermittent errors should reduce. We'll update shortly."

infra-kai: bumping DNS failover TTL to 3s to speed resolver convergence during shift:
```
./tools/dnsctl update --zone prod --record model-api.prod.redwood.internal --ttl 3
```

net-ben: reached provider NOC — they confirmed a switch fabric issue causing partial path blackholing; they estimate repair window 20-60m. asked them to provide per-prefix timeline.

oncall-zoe: given provider ETA, continue to finish staged shift to full. infra, proceed to step 3 if metrics keep improving.

infra-kai: stepping to 100% now.
```
./tools/traffic-cli shift --from us-west-1 --to us-east-1,eu-west-1 --policy staged --step 3 --confirm
```

sre-omar: post-shift metrics: error-rate for affected customers down to 0.9%, overall cluster latency stable. watch for cache warming costs.

product-ash: tracking impacted accounts. please flag enterprise tenants that still see failures so I can escalate account-level follow-up.

support-maya: two tenants still seeing intermittent errors — opening priority support channels and offering temporary SLA credits.

oncall-zoe: handoff plan: infra-kai will own stabilization and reconciliation for next 90m, then hand to night oncall. please prepare runbook checklist: route-cache flush, DNS TTL restore, verify certificates and cert rotation proxies.

infra-kai: notes for handoff:
- keep traffic distribution until provider confirms fix
- after provider RCA, gradually restore prefer=us-west-1 for routes with canary check passing
- run route-cache flush: `./infra/scripts/flush-route-cache --region us-west-1`
- check certs: `./infra/scripts/check-certs --region us-west-1`

deploy-bot: TTL restore dry-run scheduled in 10m.

sre-omar: creating incident task for postmortem: include timeline, why DNS resolvers diverged, why some prefixes blackholed, and opportunities to automate faster failover. tag #postmortems and #eng-network.

support-maya: final customer note posted. will craft tailored follow-ups for enterprise accounts after RCA.

oncall-zoe: closing active pager. channel stays open for provider updates and postmortem. thanks all for quick coordination. :thumbsup: 

incident-bot: Incident mitigated by traffic shift. Please file a postmortem within 48h and link to this thread.
